content: And we got a 50 thousand dollar ticket for construction workers peeing off the roof.
That's great. Is the electrician here today?
See, I just told you he hit a deer. Man, I knew you weren't listening to me.
You're right. I wasn't. I hear nothing.
Not a sound on the city streets, just the beat of my own heart, I think that's how it goes, something like that.
You and Patricia got engaged, didn't you? You can tell me.
What? I thought you liked Patricia.
